'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix Day 1 Steve Skilton LS It Is The Future You See (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Steve Skilton]] at [[2013 SoCal Grand Prix]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|It Is The Future You See (V) (Virtual Block 2)|VB2-L-itisthefutureyousee-pre.gif|label=It Is The Future You See (V)}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
